entities.summary: Mikhail Andreyevich Suslov was a Soviet politician during the Cold War. In addition to serving as the Central Committee's longtime Secretary of Ideology, he held office as Second Secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union from 1965 until his death in 1982.
